requirements: Compare common private values and deltas leaf by leaf.

Retain phase, cohort, p95, pause and memory diagnostics, including every overrun; these are not hidden by global acceptance.
Obtain fresh acknowledgments from all active lanes and the existing exclusive performance mutex before taking any sample.
Do not replace, unlink or bypass the existing mutex.

Hold the isolated window through the 40-trial work-form checks and acceptance evidence required by the protocol.
Record actual start, end and acceptance times only after they exist.
